name: subpair
description: Browser extension that shows two subtitle lines at once on Netflix and Jellyfin, with an optional local translation bridge.

scripts.lint:firefox: npm run build:firefox && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox
scripts.package: npm run build:firefox && npm run build:chrome && web-ext build --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir dist/packages --filename subpair-firefox-{version}.zip --overwrite-dest && web-ext build --source-dir dist/chrome --artifacts-dir dist/packages --filename subpair-chrome-{version}.zip --overwrite-dest
